requiredPatterns.name: type-level-hooks-api
requiredPatterns.message: Use db.type(...).hooks() (type-level chain), not field-level hooks

requiredPatterns.name: type-level-validate-api
requiredPatterns.message: Use db.type(...).validate() (type-level chain), not field-level validate

forbiddenPatterns.name: resolver-style-schema
forbiddenPatterns.message: TailorDB models should use db.* field builders, not resolver t.* schemas

forbiddenPatterns.name: field-level-hooks
forbiddenPatterns.message: hooks must be on db.type(...).hooks(), not chained off db.<field>(...)

forbiddenPatterns.name: field-level-validate
forbiddenPatterns.message: validate must be on db.type(...).validate(), not chained off db.<field>(...)
